translated_pages.text:
U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services
Department of Homeland Security
I-797E, Notice of Action
Notice Date: July 18, 2026
Receipt Number: IOE0987654321
REQUEST FOR EVIDENCE
We need more evidence before we can make a decision on your Form I-485.
You must submit the requested evidence within 87 days. Your response must be received by October 13, 2026.
Please submit the following evidence:
1. A copy of your birth certificate with a certified English translation.
2. Two passport-style photos taken within the last 30 days.
3. A copy of your most recent federal tax return.
Please place this notice on top of your response.
Send all of the evidence together in one package.
If you do not respond by the date above, we may consider your case abandoned.

summary_title: USCIS asks for more papers for your Form I-485

plan_steps.text: Gather each paper on the list. Make copies for yourself.
Write down questions about any paper you do not have, and ask a helper.
Mail everything in one package, with this notice on top, so it arrives before October 13, 2026.
Talk to a licensed lawyer or a DOJ-accredited representative before you send your answer.

USCIS may stop working on your case if they get no answer.
A full English translation with a signed note that it is correct.

questions_to_ask: What can I send if I do not have my birth certificate?
Does my answer need to arrive by October 13, or be mailed by then?
Can I send the papers in more than one package?
